subject: Outlier comp approval request — Priya Anand (Staff ML Infra)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: out-of-band comp + sign-on for Priya Anand (Staff ML Infra)

Team —

Following up from yesterday's debrief: we've moved quickly with Priya Anand (finalist from Cobalt) and need an exception approval to close. Key facts and ask below. I've attached the completed comp exception form and the draft offer PDF for reference.

Candidate snapshot
- Role: Staff ML Infrastructure (reports to Aditya Rao)
- Location: SF Bay Area (remote-eligible)
- Current comp: $260k base + 0.3% equity at current employer; strong infra/LLM ops experience, led cross-region KV cache rollout at scale
- Time-sensitive: final interview was 8/20; candidate has another late-stage conversation scheduled next week

Proposed package (out-of-band request)
- Base: $290,000 (above band midpoint for Staff)
- Sign-on: $60,000 one-time (to offset realized equity loss)
- Equity: 0.45% (equity refresh relative uplift vs standard band)
- Note: we are requesting a limited exception — full bump to base + sign-on + elevated equity refresh — to secure immediate acceptance

Rationale
- Recruiting: candidate is market-levered and has competing late-stage offers; hiring manager (Aditya) indicates high ramp leverage for our inference runtime roadmap
- Business: this hire reduces projected infra rollout timeline by ~3 months and materially improves throughput on hot models (customer impact)
- Retention/Cost: upfront sign-on reduces LT dilution risk and is more efficient than higher base long-term; equity refresh is required to match relocation/realization gap

Ask
- Requesting approval from Compensation (Rishi), TA/People (Laura) and Exec exceptions (Marissa) to proceed with this package.
- If we get approvals today, we can send the offer and aim for a 48-hour turnaround.

Attachments: comp_exception_form.xlsx, Offer_PRIYA_ANAND_v2.pdf

Thanks — I can jump on a quick sync if helpful.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: out-of-band comp + sign-on for Priya Anand (Staff ML Infra)

Thanks Monica — quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
1) Is the $290k base a permanent uplift relative to our published Staff band or a one-time bridging adjustment? (doc shows base = $290k)
2) Is the sign-on fully cash or partial RSU? If cash, need justification for size vs precedent — $60k is above our typical sign-on for this band.
3) For equity: 0.45% total or an initial grant plus refresh schedule? Please call out any target refresh cadence in the comp_exception_form.

Context: I want to be sure we (a) preserve band integrity and (b) document the business impact and retention rationale so we can treat this as an exception with a sunset clause. If we can structure sign-on as 50% cash + 50% RSU cliff at 6 months, that reduces cash pressure and is often acceptable to candidates.

If Monica/Aditya can confirm the above I can provisionally approve subject to Marissa signing off on the one-time cash component.

—Rishi
Head of Compensation & Benefits
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: out-of-band comp + sign-on for Priya Anand (Staff ML Infra)

+1 to moving quickly here given product impact. A few practical asks before formal approval:
- Please convert the $60k sign-on to a 50/50 cash + RSU split as Rishi suggested (30k cash up front, 30k RSU cliff at 6 months). That preserves our cash cadence and gives the candidate upside aligned to performance.
- Reduce base to $285k (still above band midpoint, but less of an outlier). Keep equity at 0.45% with a performance-based refresh clause at 12 months (documented in comp form).

I have authority to approve up to $40k of one-time cash sign-on; anything above that needs Marissa's OK. Attaching a lightly edited offer PDF reflecting Laura's recommended numbers (Offer_PRIYA_ANAND_v2.pdf).

LMK — I'm fully supportive of Laura's adjusted numbers (Base $285k / Sign-on $30k cash + $30k RSU @6mo / Equity 0.45% w/ 12mo refresh clause). Priya's hands-on infra background will shave months off our rollout and unblock several enterprise customers currently on the waitlist.

A little more color for approvals:
- Candidate timeline: Priya wants an offer by Tues 8/25 and a start date target of 10/05.
- Impact: Priya's KV cache design work maps directly to the latency reductions we promised to Beta customers; we estimate $150k ARR uplift in H1 next year attributable to this work (conservative).
- Commit: Aditya (hiring manager) will own a 30-day onboarding plan and initial deliverables; manager OKs performance refresh at 12 months based on delivery.

If Marissa can sign off on the cash component >$40k or confirm Laura's $30k cash cap, we can issue immediately. Candidate is flexible on RSU split if we need to trade sign-on vs upfront equity.

—Aditya
Director, ML Infrastructure

Subject: Re: Request: out-of-band comp + sign-on for Priya Anand (Staff ML Infra) — FINAL APPROVAL

Team —

After reviewing the comp exception form and the business case, I approve the following (final):
- Base: $285,000 (per Laura/Aditya)
- Sign-on: $30,000 cash up front + $30,000 RSU vesting cliff at 6 months (total $60k package, structured)
- Equity: 0.45% initial grant with a documented performance-based refresh review at 12 months (per comp form)

Conditions and notes:
1) Sign-on cash capped at $30k; any future requests >$30k cash will require CFO/CEO concurrence.
2) Offer letter must include a 12-month performance check tied to the refresh schedule.
3) Compensation will be recorded as a formal exception in Workday/Comp records and summarized to leadership for audit.

Next steps for TA/Recruiting (Monica):
- Update Offer_PRIYA_ANAND_v2.pdf with the final numbers and send via DocuSign link.
- Use the approved comp_exception_form.xlsx as the record (upload to HR case).
- Aim to send by 8/24 EOD to meet candidate timeline.

Thanks for the clear business justification and quick turnaround. Let's get this wrapped.

—Marissa Cole
VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference
